thread:
Ben: DataLoom wants a 24h guaranteed POC reservation in us-west-2: 4 A100-equivalent GPUs, pool-scoped API key, and VPC peering. Need fast estimate + checklist. Can someone own this?

Tara: I can own coordination. Quick Qs: exact start/end, peak QPS, avg tokens? Guaranteed only?

Ben: Start=2026-05-10T14:00:00Z end=2026-05-11T14:00:00Z. Peak ~900 reqs/min, avg ~400 tokens. They requested guaranteed reserve for demo.

PoolOps: Capacity available in us-west-2. Guaranteed reservation requires payment (PO or card). We can spin a 4-GPU reserved pool and attach an expiring API key. ETA to provision after approvals = ~2 hours.

Finance: Ballpark pricing: $26/hr per GPU. 4 GPUs -> $104/hr -> 24h = $2,496. Add $200 ops fee. Quote $2.8k to cover minor adjustments.

Security: Before peering: signed DPA, short security questionnaire (data types, retention, admin contact), customer ASN and allowed CIDRs, and KMS approach. Also require confirmation demo data has no sensitive PII.

OpsBot: Example autoscale/burst config we'll apply to the pool:
```
autoscale:
 min_replicas: 1
 max_replicas: 8
 burst_policy:
   reserved_gpus: 4
   mode: guaranteed
 cooldown_seconds: 600
```
Note: reserved_gpus enforces billing for the window.

Tara: Can we issue a pool-scoped API key with TTL + IP allowlist?

PoolOps: Yes. We'll create key like `dataloom-poc-zzzz` expiring 2026-05-11T15:00:00Z and can lock to CIDR if provided. Provide billing contact and PO/card to proceed.

Ben: Billing contact = billing@dataloom.ai, PO pending but card available for start. VPC CIDR = 10.20.0.0/16. I'll send the DPA and the questionnaire now.

Finance: Once card or PO on file we'll provision. I'll prepare the $2.8k estimate and payment link.

Security: Received questionnaire answers. Peering will be enabled after DPA signed.

PoolOps: Tentative reservation queued. Will provision after payment and DPA. Provision ETA = 2 hours; will post pool name and API key on completion.

Tara: Thanks team — I'll update customer and post back when PO/card are done. :thumbsup:
